g.text: Figure 7B User Requirement Diagram — Human Judgement and Interaction
(SysML requirement notation expressed in PlantUML; source: spec 3.0-3.2, 12.4)
text = "Enable a single RCA to complete
text = "Log AI calls, human actions, transitions,
rule runs, external acts and failures"
text = "Audit plan approved by RCA before
As the RCA, I work with the system through one
entry point that passes on my decisions word for
word, and a form takes over when that entry point
is unavailable. Execution does not start until I
approve the audit plan, which keeps a version
each time it is revised; when I overrule an AI
judgment I must write down why. AI calls, my own
actions and every state change are all logged.
Later, I would like to review from my phone,
issue reports in other languages, and let my
Box «requirement» = one requirement, carrying its id and text.
Crosshair line (+--) = SysML containment; the crosshair sits on the container.
Dashed arrow «deriveReqt» = the derived requirement points at its source.
Other requirements: Figure 7A (Member A), Figure 7C (Member C); full set in Figure 7.
